info.name: Recruitment Platform
info.description: Postman collection for the backend recruitment platform. Requests follow the current backend source code contract.

request.description: Public. Registers a new company and admin user. Expected status: 201. Response shape: { token, user }.
Public. Logs in with valid credentials. Expected status: 200. Response shape: { token, user }.
Protected. Any authenticated ADMIN or RECRUITER. Gets current user info. Expected status: 200.
Public in the current backend route. Clears auth cookie if present. Expected status: 200.
Protected. ADMIN only. Creates a recruiter in the authenticated user's company. Expected status: 201.
Protected. ADMIN only. Lists users in the authenticated user's company. Expected status: 200.
Protected. ADMIN only. Gets a user detail from the authenticated user's company. Expected status: 200 or 404.
Protected. ADMIN only. Deletes a user in the authenticated user's company. Expected status: 200 or 404.

request.description: Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Creates a position for the authenticated user's company. Expected status: 201.
Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Lists company positions with pagination and sorting. Expected status: 200.
Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Gets a position detail in the authenticated user's company. Expected status: 200 or 404.

request.description: Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Updates a position in the authenticated user's company. Expected status: 200 or 404.
Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Deletes a position in the authenticated user's company. Expected status: 200 or 404.
Public. Creates an applicant for an active position. No Authorization header. Expected status: 201.
Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Lists applicants for the authenticated company with pagination, sorting, positionId filter, and status filter. Expected status: 200.
Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Gets applicant detail if the applicant belongs to a position in the authenticated company. Expected status: 200 or 404.
Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Updates applicant status. Expected status: 200 or 404.
Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Adds or updates applicant notes. Expected status: 200 or 404.
Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Deletes applicant if it belongs to the authenticated company. Expected status: 200 or 404.
Public. Lists all active positions from all companies. No Authorization header. Expected status: 200.
Public. Searches active positions by title or description. No Authorization header. Expected status: 200.
Public. Filters active positions by location. No Authorization header. Expected status: 200.
Public. Filters active positions by type. No Authorization header. Expected status: 200.
Public. Combines search, location, and type filters. No Authorization header. Expected status: 200.
Public. Gets one active public position detail with full description. Inactive or missing positions return 404. No Authorization header.
Public. Login as Company A admin from seed data. Expected status: 200. Saves token.
Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Expected: only positions from Company A are returned.
Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Expected: only applicants for Company A positions are returned.
Protected. Set positionId manually to a Company B position while logged in as Company A. Expected status: 404.

item.name: Try Company B Applicant Status Update

request.description: Protected. Set applicantId manually to a Company B applicant while logged in as Company A. Expected status: 404.
Public. Login as Company A recruiter from seed data. Expected status: 200. Saves token.
Protected. ADMIN only endpoint called as RECRUITER. Expected status: 403.
Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Expected status: 201. Saves positionId.
Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Expected status: 200 when positionId belongs to the current company.
Protected endpoint without Authorization header. Expected status: 401.
Protected endpoint with invalid Bearer token. Expected status: 401.
Public. Login with valid credentials. Expected status: 200. Saves token for protected requests.
Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Uses Authorization: Bearer {{token}}. Expected status: 200.
Public. Login as recruiter. Expected status: 200. Saves token.

request.description: Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Creates an active position and saves positionId. Expected status: 201.

Protected. ADMIN or RECRUITER. Adds notes to the applicant. Expected status: 200.
